notes.title: PATCH V6.04
notes.content:
Changes.

 Removed all the test maps.
 Added "Flying Island" map.
 Optimized multiplayer game.
 Reworked combat mechanics.
 Fixed errors with bombs.
 Blast effects updated.
 New bonus (running speed).
 New characters added.
 New bombs added.
 Added new tasks.
 Fixed minor and major bugs.

notes.title: The tournament has begun!
notes.content:
As of this minute, the tournament has begun!
The tournament will run until February 28, 2022 at 10:00 AM Pacific Time.

Updates

 In the rankings section, a tournament section has been added.
 Added ranking above the Player Icon (ranking position, match wins, number of kills).
 Added two new missions.
 A new map has been added.
 Prices for characters and bombs have been increased.
 Fixed various minor bugs.
